package gostrict_test

import "go.wdy.de/nago/pkg/gostrict"

// Replacement of n22_names_test.go for the counter run against nago f4aca80c5 only (go test -overlay, see
// testdata/n22/overlay.json): the lists go element by element over the fast writer and reader, as a host wrote and read
// them before N22. It is no part of the suite.

func n22WriteFloat64s(w gostrict.Writer, v []float64) {
	w.List(len(v))
	for _, x := range v {
		w.Float64(x)
	}
	w.End()
}

func n22WriteInt64s(w gostrict.Writer, v []int64) {
	w.List(len(v))
	for _, x := range v {
		w.Int64(x)
	}
	w.End()
}

func n22ReadFloat64s(r gostrict.Reader) []float64 {
	n := r.List()
	v := make([]float64, n)
	for i := range v {
		v[i] = r.Float64()
	}
	r.End()
	return v
}

func n22ReadInt64s(r gostrict.Reader) []int64 {
	n := r.List()
	v := make([]int64, n)
	for i := range v {
		v[i] = r.Int64()
	}
	r.End()
	return v
}
